I read the panel D trace against the dashed line at 96.8%. Every reading is either 97% or higher (above the line) or 96% (below it), so a crossing happens whenever the trace moves between 96% and 97% or higher.

The trace dips to 96% at four points: about minute 17, minute 36, minute 116, and minute 167. Each dip goes below the line and then comes back up, so each produces two crossings: one down and one up. The 4 dips give 4 × 2 = 8 crossings.

FINAL ANSWER: 8
